recipe.name: Malabar Mood
recipe.description: A vibrant tropical Scotch cocktail balancing lush pineapple and coconut with citrus brightness and an earthy, herbal whisper of fresh curry leaves.
steps: Place 5 curry leaves into the bottom of a cocktail shaker and muddle gently to release aromatic oils without tearing.
Add the Dewar's White Label, pineapple juice, orange juice, coconut cream, and optional lime juice.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake vigorously for 15 seconds until chilled and well integrated.
Double strain the mixture into a chilled highball glass packed with fresh crushed ice.
recipe.garnish: A slapped curry leaf sprig and a dehydrated orange wheel
